🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 6,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 0 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Loud-Eyes and lived to sit here. They faced Big Ugly and lived to sit here. 1 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
